Ekyokwagiza: C. Okuhurikana kw’amaatomu

Ekishemerezi kya feromagnetism kyajja ku maatomu agafite amaelekitironi aganyuma (unpaired electrons) agakura ebizibu by’obumanyizi (magnetic moments). Ebi bizibu birihurira mu by’aamaanyi ebya “domaini” ebyegerana mu gice ky’ematomu, era domaini zino zikyuka omuri omuriro ogw’eby’obutonde (external magnetic field) zoteerera okuhurikira mu ntegeka emu. Omuriro ogwo gulaga omusingi gw’obusimbwe bw’amaatomu n’okuhurikana kw’amaatomu, kibaatuma ekintu kiba feromagnetiki (ng’enteeka y’ensimbi eziriko iron oba cobalt) kigumya okuraga oburungi okubirabwa n’olaruzinga. Katonda abaana bashemererwa kwekora eky’ozo kuba bakenera domaini eziyitirize n’okuhurukira kwa magnetic moments mu atomu omu kutoora n’okugereranya obusingye bwa feromagnetism.
